description: Read the complete public rules for one SnackTurn game, including controls, completion conditions, account requirements and saved progress. Use a slug from find_games. Returns the same reviewed bilingual rules as the website. Does not return case answers or a player’s saved game.

language.description: Language of the returned content and links.

slug.description: Stable game slug from find_games, for example bluff or tiny-case.
